description: Korean localization for the DM feature. Replace all hardcoded English strings in DM components with react-intl messages, and add both English and Korean translations.
steps: 1. Identify all hardcoded strings in DM components: 'Messages' (chat_room_list_header.tsx), 'New message' (title attr), 'Search conversations...' (placeholder), 'Loading...' (chat_room_list.tsx, chat_room_view.tsx), 'Loading your conversation history...' (migration banner), 'member'/'members' (chat_room_header.tsx), 'Back' (title attr), 'Room settings' (title attr), 'Emoji' (title attr), 'Attach file' (title attr), 'Type a message...' (message_compose.tsx placeholder), 'Send' (title attr), 'Select a conversation' (empty_state.tsx), 'Choose an existing conversation or start a new one.' (empty_state.tsx), 'New Message' (new_chat_room_modal.tsx title), 'Close' (aria-label), 'To:' (label), 'Search people...' (placeholder), 'Group name (optional)' (placeholder), 'Start conversation' (button), 'Failed to send. Tap to retry' (message_item.tsx), 'Chat {id}' fallback in chat_room_header.tsx

2. Add i18n message definitions to each DM component using react-intl's defineMessages pattern. Import useIntl and defineMessages from react-intl. Define messages at the top of each file with IDs like 'dm.chat_room_list.title', 'dm.compose.placeholder', etc. Use intl.formatMessage() for attributes (title, placeholder, aria-label) and <FormattedMessage> for inline text.
3. Add English translations to app/javascript/mastodon/locales/en.json - add all dm.* keys with English values in alphabetical order within the file.

4. Add Korean translations to app/javascript/mastodon/locales/ko.json - add all dm.* keys with Korean values: 'Messages' -> '메시지', 'New message' -> '새 메시지', 'Search conversations...' -> '대화 검색...', 'Loading...' -> '로딩 중...', 'Loading your conversation history...' -> '대화 기록을 불러오는 중...', 'member' -> '명', 'Back' -> '뒤로', 'Room settings' -> '채팅방 설정', 'Emoji' -> '이모지', 'Attach file' -> '파일 첨부', 'Type a message...' -> '메시지를 입력하세요...', 'Send' -> '보내기', 'Select a conversation' -> '대화를 선택하세요', 'Choose an existing conversation or start a new one.' -> '기존 대화를 선택하거나 새로운 대화를 시작하세요.', 'New Message' -> '새 메시지', 'Close' -> '닫기', 'To:' -> '받는 사람:', 'Search people...' -> '사람 검색...', 'Group name (optional)' -> '그룹 이름 (선택사항)', 'Start conversation' -> '대화 시작', 'Failed to send. Tap to retry' -> '전송 실패. 탭하여 재시도', '{count} members' -> '{count}명'
acceptance_criteria: No hardcoded English strings remain in DM component TSX files (except technical identifiers)
All DM strings use react-intl defineMessages/useIntl/FormattedMessage pattern
en.json contains all dm.* translation keys with English values
ko.json contains all dm.* translation keys with Korean values
verification: Run: cd /projects/sandbox/mastodon && npx tsc --noEmit --project tsconfig.json 2>&1 | head -50
Verify en.json has dm entries: grep -c '"dm\.' app/javascript/mastodon/locales/en.json
Verify ko.json has dm entries: grep -c '"dm\.' app/javascript/mastodon/locales/ko.json

Verify no hardcoded user-facing strings remain: grep -n 'Loading\|Messages\|Search\|Failed to send' app/javascript/mastodon/features/dm/components/*.tsx | grep -v 'intl\|defineMessages\|formatMessage\|FormattedMessage\|import'
findings: All 7 DM components updated with react-intl. 23 translation keys added to both en.json and ko.json. TypeScript compiles cleanly. chat_room_view.tsx also has a Loading... string but was not listed in the task scope so left unchanged.
